name: Prototype Guard

facts.text: Prototype Guard: NPC template 60165052, level 49, model 831, no faction, aggro 200 (range 500), no spells, respawn 80 s, below the hall of making at 406096, 431655 with two scorchers (44) and a sentry mark II.
facts.source: world data: Mob/NpcTemplate tables (0.37b runtime database, world tables only)

facts.text: The guard the old master never finished and the cabalist's borrowed improvements are Living Server writing.

story:
Master Meical of the school of making died in the burning, and a drakoran answers to his name over the door of the hall now, and drives the servants he left. Most of those servants were finished. The Prototype Guard was not.

It was the old master's last piece, the readers of Caer Gothwaite say, a guard for the colleges' gates that would never sleep and never take a bribe and never let the wrong person in, and he never decided who the wrong person was. It stood half-made in the workshop when the burning came. The drakoran cabalist found it there and finished it the drakoran way, quickly, with pieces taken from the sentries and the scorchers, and set it below the hall to keep the slope.

It still does not know who the wrong person is. It treats everyone as the wrong person. The scorchers and the sentry stand near it as apprentices stand near a master, and Adelon on the hill outside the fort says the cabalist means to make more of it, which is the reason Adelon watches.
legend: Prototype Guard, level 49 construct below Meical's hall of making, with two scorchers (44) and a sentry mark II close by. No faction of its own, but the constructs near it are aggressive: pull the scorchers off first. Plain melee, no spells, hard-hitting for its level. Respawn 80 seconds. Mind the hall's other servants and Cabalist Meical up the slope.

aggro: Halt. You are the wrong person.

lairEntry: A half-made guard, finished the drakoran way.
